text:
incident-bot: [ALERT] KV cache eviction surge detected on gw-prod-*-pool — paging activity > 70% above baseline for quantized AWQ models. Auto-escalation to #incidents.

maria: saw this at 02:07 UTC, tails spiked to 3s+ on several routes. grafana: https://grafana/redwood/d/kv_evictions

dave: oncall taking this — rerouting to me. quick summary?

sre-lead: metrics: kv resident set increased ~4x since 02:00, eviction rate jumped 80%. Disk IO paging up, several GPUs showing high memory pressure.

eng-ml: suspicious — we rolled a kernel selection tweak to prefer awq-int8 kernels at 01:50 across the fleet (rollout id rk-2026-03-15-kernel). Could be regressing kv footprint due to different kv layout.

maria: customer impact: AcmePay and StellarForms reported timeouts and 502s, roughly 0.6% of tenant traffic experiencing errors, 5% tail latency regression for affected models. CS already pinged AcmePay. cs-rep: we let them know we're investigating; they're watching.

eng-ml: logs show kv_size per request for AWQ models increased from ~1.2MB to ~4.8MB after kernel flip. Key-value page allocations look misaligned with our packing expectations.

maria: initial mitigation idea: revert kernel selection to previous fp16/awq-safe path for prod, and throttle continuous-batching settings to force smaller batch sizes.

eng-ml: agree. two-prong: (1) kernel rollback on affected nodes (2) runtime config hotfix: set cont_batch.max_tokens=800 and cont_batch.max_batch=8 to reduce KV buildup and avoid long-lived contexts.

maria: can we push config via runtime flags immediately?

deploy-bot: deploy request received: user=dave, action=apply-runtime-config, target=gw-prod-*-pool, config=cont_batch.{max_tokens:800,max_batch:8}, change_id=hotfix-2309991234.

dave: applying to 10% canary first, then 50%. will also push a kernel tag pin: kernel.strategy=legacy-fallback for canary hosts.

eng-ml: note: pinning kernel to legacy-fallback disables awq-int8 perf path; expect increase in per-token latency ~5-10% but reduces kv footprint significantly. acceptable for emergency.

maria: rolling canary now. canary hosts show immediate drop in kv resident set on those hosts to baseline within one minute. eviction rate normalizing.

cs-rep: AcmePay reporting improvement on canary traffic. :thumbsup:

maria: proceeding to 50% after validation window. monitoring logs for any errors.

sre-lead: also enabling more aggressive eviction GC for affected workers: kv.eviction_policy=aggressive, kv.eviction_threshold=0.65 — temp measure.

eng-ml: we also need to collect traces to root-cause the packing change. please attach memstats + kernel selection logs for nodes that flipped. sample command: ```sudo rd-agent collect-mem --since 01:30 --nodes gw-prod-*-pool > /tmp/kv-memdump.tgz```

maria: logs and dumps uploaded to s3://redwood-incident-dumps/2309991234/ (private).

dave: now at 50% canary; eviction rate down 60% overall, tail latency improving. preparing to full rollout.

deploy-bot: deploy complete: action=apply-runtime-config roll to 100% started. change_id=hotfix-2309991234.

maria: full rollout completed. KV resident sets back to baseline fleet-wide. paging dropped to normal. still keeping aggressive eviction config for next 30m.

eng-ml: follow-up: create PR to revert kernel strategy change and add integration test that measures kv footprint under AWQ-int8 kernels for long contexts. root cause hypothesis: awq-int8 kernel introduced different KV packing alignment that increases per-token KV metadata for some attention layouts.

sre-lead: incident owner assignment: dave. postmortem owner: maria. severity: Sev2. timeline: initial alert 2309991234 -> mitigation complete 2309991357.

cs-rep: I filed a customer follow-up ticket to AcmePay and StellarForms; they'll want postmortem and timeline.

eng-ml: temp rollback note: disabled awq-int8 path for 03:00 window. will plan a careful canary with additional KV mem profiling before re-enabling.

maria: action items: 1) PR to revert kernel rollout + add kv footprint test (eng-ml) 2) add runtime guardrails to rollback kernel selection automatically if kv resident set > 2x baseline within 10m (eng-platform) 3) postmortem draft (maria) 4) customer comms (cs-rep).

dave: handing off to next oncall @sre-night for monitoring + follow-ups. leaving channel. :wave:

incident-bot: handoff: dave -> sre-night at 2309991357.

maria: closing incident channel but keeping monitoring alarm at elevated sensitivity for next 2 hours. will attach dumps and timeline to the postmortem.

sre-lead: good job team. note for retrospective: consider adding kv-size regression test in CI for quantized kernels and a canary metric for kv-resident-set changes.

eng-ml: I'll start the profiling run now and open the revert PR.

cs-rep: customers informed; they asked for ETA on full write-up. aiming EOD.

maria: thanks all.
